mapper.select: SELECT o.status::text AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "order".orders o WHERE o.is_active = TRUE AND o.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY o.status
mapper.sql: WHERE o.is_active = TRUE AND o.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') AND o.estimated_completion_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_completion_at < NOW()
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, CONCAT_WS(' ', v.brand, v.model) AS vehicleLabel, v.license_plate AS vehicleLicensePlate, o.status::text AS status, o.estimated_completion_at AS estimatedCompletionAt, (CURRENT_DATE - o.estimated_completion_at::date) AS daysOverdue FROM "order".orders o LEFT JOIN vehicle.vehicles v ON v.id = o.vehicle_id
ORDER BY o.estimated_completion_at ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, CONCAT_WS(' ', v.brand, v.model) AS vehicleLabel, v.license_plate AS vehicleLicensePlate, o.status::text AS status, o.estimated_completion_at AS estimatedCompletionAt FROM "order".orders o LEFT JOIN vehicle.vehicles v ON v.id = o.vehicle_id WHERE o.is_active = TRUE AND o.status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order".orders o WHERE o.is_active = TRUE AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM billing.invoices inv WHERE inv.order_id = o.id AND inv.status <> 'CANCELLED' )
mapper.sql: WHERE i.status = 'ISSUED' AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM billing.credit_notes cn WHERE cn.original_invoice_id = i.id AND cn.status = 'ISSUED' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_gross), 0) AS total FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = i.id

SELECT i.id AS id, i.invoice_number AS invoiceNumber, i.customer_name_snapshot AS customerName, i.due_date AS dueDate, COALESCE(t.total_gross, 0) AS amount, (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) AS daysOverdue FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = i.id
ORDER BY i.due_date ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.status = 'DRAFT'

SELECT issued.current_month - credited.current_month AS currentMonth, issued.previous_month - credited.previous_month AS previousMonth FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_gross) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS current_month, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_gross) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')), 0) AS previous_month FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.status IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID') AND i.issue_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') ) AS issued CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_gross) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', cn.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS current_month, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_gross) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', cn.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')), 0) AS previous_month FROM billing.credit_notes cn LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = cn.original_invoice_id WHERE cn.status = 'ISSUED' AND cn.issue_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') ) AS credited

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS totalCurrentMonth, COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')), 0) AS totalPreviousMonth, COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE oi.item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS materialCurrentMonth, COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE oi.item_type = 'MATERIAL' AND date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')), 0) AS materialPreviousMonth, COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE oi.item_type = 'LABOR' AND date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS laborCurrentMonth, COALESCE(SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) FILTER ( WHERE oi.item_type = 'LABOR' AND date_trunc('month', i.issue_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')), 0) AS laborPreviousMonth FROM "order".order_items oi JOIN "order".orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.status IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID') AND i.credited_at IS NULL WHERE oi.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND i.issue_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')

WITH rev AS ( SELECT month, SUM(amount) AS revenue, SUM(invoice) AS invoiceCount FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.issue_date)::int AS month, COALESCE(t.total_gross, 0) AS amount, 1 AS invoice FROM billing.invoices i LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.status IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.issue_date) = #{year} UNION ALL
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cn.issue_date)::int, -COALESCE(t.total_gross, 0), 0 FROM billing.credit_notes cn LEFT JOIN billing.v_invoice_price_totals t ON t.invoice_id = cn.original_invoice_id WHERE cn.status = 'ISSUED' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cn.issue_date) = #{year} ) AS revenue_rows GROUP BY month ), mar AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM i.issue_date)::int AS month, SUM((oi.unit_price - oi.purchase_price) * oi.quantity) AS margin FROM "order".order_items oi JOIN "order".orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.status IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID') AND i.credited_at IS NULL WHERE oi.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.issue_date) = #{year} GROUP BY 1 ), ord AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.created_at)::int AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM "order".orders o WHERE o.is_active = TRUE AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at) = #{year} GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT COALESCE(rev.month, mar.month, ord.month) AS month, COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(mar.margin, 0) AS margin, COALESCE(ord.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(rev.invoiceCount, 0) AS invoiceCount FROM rev FULL JOIN mar ON mar.month = rev.month FULL JOIN ord ON ord.month = COALESCE(rev.month, mar.month) ORDER BY month

SELECT year FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.issue_date)::int AS year FROM billing.invoices i WHERE i.status IN ('ISSUED', 'PAID') UNION SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.created_at)::int FROM "order".orders o WHERE o.is_active = TRUE ) y ORDER BY year DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse.goods_receipts WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
SELECT id AS id, note AS note, opened_at AS openedAt FROM warehouse.stock_takes WHERE status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id AS id, v.license_plate AS licensePlate, CONCAT_WS(' ', v.brand, v.model) AS label, v.stk_valid_until AS stkValidUntil, (v.stk_valid_until < CURRENT_DATE) AS expired FROM vehicle.vehicles v WHERE v.is_active = TRUE AND v.stk_valid_until IS NOT NULL AND v.stk_valid_until <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY v.stk_valid_until ASC
